notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
Hello blacksmiths,

We want to reassure all of You that game is still in development. After receiving feedback from our publisher we are busy with optimization, improving the dialogues, adding new languages, and overall debugging. We will need few more months to polish the game.

notes.title: Ironsmith Medieval Simulator - SHIPS
notes.content:
Hello fellow blacksmiths,

In our game we have random events implemented, they happens every few minutes, one of them we would like to show you is merchant ships arrival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905399/911732b27cbb455b023075fb43c40a925ca05191.jpg[/img]


Ships have a strong impact on the cities economy, you can buy different resources for cheaper prices than you would get in local merchants.

There is few types of ships, which sell different things:
- Wood
- Iron
- Coal

notes.title: Ironsmith Medieval Simulator - Devlog#1. Engraving System
notes.content:
[b]Hello there, blacksmiths.[/b]
From now on we will start the weekly devlogs, as we make progress we'll send you some sneak peeks of the features in our game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33905399/e4a91b8648188edf60cb97f896df1017638b6a9d.jpg[/img]
Video demonstration:
https://youtu.be/mdK0y_3XGV8

Today we would like to introduce you to engraving system in the game. Mainly, a sword is made of four components:

- Blade 
- Garde
- Handle
- Pommel

Each of these parts can be fully customised by engraving performed on working table. As the progress in the game goes forward, the player will eventually be able to unlock more features and styles to customise weapons in whatever style he likes.


What do you think about it? Is there anything else you want to see in engraving system or the game itself?
